source_evidence: The services your broker provides and what fees you pay may be negotiable, but will ultimately depend on your account agreement with your broker.
answer: A broker’s account agreement helps define the services you receive and the fees you pay; those terms may be negotiable, but ultimately depend on the agreement. Read and understand it, along with the broker’s relationship summary, so you can review what services and costs apply to your account. If the broker offers recommendations, also read its Regulation Best Interest disclosures.
